reviews.title: Stole my money. Don’t do it!
reviews.text: Do not get involved with this betting app. It is a good motivator, but that’s all it is. Today I checked my account because I was going to use my balance to buy another round of diet betting, but when I got in I saw that they had taken my $82.78 aware and transferred it somewhere for no reason. Then again this July they cleaned out the rest of my $82.78 and stated that my “points expired”. I was in and out of the hospitals for multiple surgeries during the time period that my appoints apparently “expired” and it was not recommended for me to exercise consistently (enough to lose wait) and the surgeries had my weight plunging and skyrocketing and there wasn’t a scale at the hospitals for me to take a selfie on. Now I was using this as a kind of savings account that I could keep earning on when I felt the need to take a challenge. It might say it now that the points will expire, but it didn’t say that the last time I used the app. So they stole my $165.56 away from me. And you have to put your OWN MONEY IN. I could understand if it were reward money, but I actually had to pay to get into the diet games. Looking for a lawyer to start a class action lawsuit. Anyone interested to do it with us? UPDATE: THEY STILL HAVE MY MONEY, so if you’re dumb enough to put any money in, TAKE EVERY CENT OUT AS YOU WIN! THAT WAY THE MOST YOU WILL LOSE IS WHAT YOU JUST PLACED ABET ON. DO NOT GIVE THEM YOUR NUMBER.

reviews.title: Another Tool in the “Weight Loss Toolkit”!
reviews.text: As someone who has “battled the bulge” for most of my life, I am often looking for tools to help me keep my weight in check. DietBet is a wonder tool to use to lose or maintain weight. The customer service is top-notch and the differing levels of support (weight loss, exercise, nutrition) has proven to be excellent!

reviews.title: Warning- be careful!
reviews.text: I won the game. Afterwards, I opted to cash out the points and get money. My account shows the points have been deducted but no money has been deposited into any account that I have. I tried to contact customer support and the email is out of service. Sounds fishy to me! If I haven’t received my payment or a response that assures me they are working on it by tomorrow then I will be filing a complaint with the BBB. Taking money in this manner is called theft!

reviews.title: Unfair - they will take your $100 & run
reviews.text: I signed up for Diet Bet to lose 4% body weight, which I BARELY hit. I submitted my final weigh-in and have been told that I need to resubmit because they can’t clearly read all the numbers on my scale. Well, that’s because the top lines on my digital scale are very dim but you can clearly tell what number is populating on the scale. I have been submitting weigh-ins for weeks on this exact scale & NOW that I’ve submitted my final weigh-in on the SAME SCALE I’ve been using the WHOLE time, they don’t want to accept it. And I can’t run out to the store to get the same one I’ve been using. I have to order it, which I could have done had they told me my scale was unacceptable in the first place.

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: I’ve tried this a few times and actually “won” this last month. There was about 130k in the pot between about 2500 people but after DietBet takes their cut we all won about $2.00. Yep, that’s right. I suppose it can be helpful motivation…but now it just feels like a scam to take more money and add shame to overweight people. They need more transparency and better rewards for winners.

reviews.title: Diet bet takes a huge portion
reviews.text: Depending on your “monthly bet” $0-99 they take 25% of the pot. They took over $30,000 from the pot. If over 75% had won, you wouldn’t even win back your money. You’re basically betting that other people will not make it. Betting over $100 20% is taken. Betting over $250 a month 15% is taken. Betting over $500 a month 10% is taken. Do not be scammed into buying the membership, your odds of winning their little gadget are next to nothing and it’s not required and then you won’t win ANYTHING, because they $5 is not in the pot of your dietbet. If you would like to pay $40 and hope to get it back (ie hope others lose) for the support found in these groups, everyone is very nice. But you can get into free Facebook groups and find the same helpfulness maybe even more. It’s hard to find where someone replied to your comment and comment back. All you see is their comment in your notifications with no ability to reply there, you have to go search for it. so they’re not using their winnings to make the app good. I won’t be doing any more of these. Scam. They’re taking too much. They could keep the app as junky as it is with the $5 membership fee. No one cares about the weekly prizes, they never win. Quit giving those away and you’ve now saved enough to “keep the lights on” as their team calls their cut of $30,000.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: The app itself works well and so is the idea behind the app - it motivates you to lose wait. But there are a few reasons why this app is a scam/moneymaker for the company. First, you don’t “win” much. DietBet takes a significant cut. I started off winning about $35, then subsequent games I won $8, $5, and $1.5. After you factor out a $5 membership, you’ve walked away with very little or are in the hole. Second, 4% of body wait, which is the typical amount you need to lose in a game, is tough to do and borderline unhealthy over a 4 week span. I get that DietBet needs a cut to pay the referees and operate the app, but they are definitely pulling in good profit for very little output.

Everyone is in this together and helps each other by sharing their stories and giving encouragement.

However, the pictures they were requesting were not at all normally asked for and I felt like they were targeting me specifically. This app takes your money - don’t use it.

reviews.title: Excellent Motivation!
reviews.text: I have used Diet Bet for 8 years and it has consistently been helpful and motivating in losing weight. I value the community, those who lead the challenges, and the accountability of membership that helps increase the likelihood that I’ll hit my goals. Many games also have mini challenges and games within them that keep you inspired. It’s also encouraging to hear from others and their health journeys. I highly recommend this app and program to support your health and weight loss journey!
